A [[Trandoshan]] [[Gender|male]] '''manager''' worked for the [[Pyke Syndicate]] at a [[spice]] shipping dock on the [[planet]] [[Oba Diah]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Rafa Martez|Rafa]] and [[Trace Martez]] tried to steal spice from the dock in order to trick the [[Pyke]]s, but a [[Unidentified Toong worker|worker]] requested assistance from the manager. Upon learning that the [[Martez family|Martez sisters]] were not authorized to collect spice, the Trandoshan attempted to fight Rafa Martez, who managed to drop him off of a cliff, where he fell to his [[death]].<ref name="Together Again" />
